# One

Mira crossed the yard with the bronze sword on her hip. She knew the
gate would be locked. Aleksandr had said as much, and Aleksandr was
seldom wrong about gates.

"You're late," he said.

"The road was flooded," Mira said. She felt the weight of the sword and
wondered whether she should have left it behind.

The lantern guttered. The wind rose. The night went on without them.

***

Aleksandr thought about the letter for a long while. He wondered whether
Mira had read it. He knew she had. Mira knew he knew, and neither of them
said anything about it, which was how they had always managed.
